question: Will OpenClaw sponsor RFC 0016’s core Claw lifecycle and this managed workspace-file slice?
rationale: The RFC remains unaccepted and human discussion questions feature-PR eligibility, so automation cannot decide whether this new persistent core lifecycle should exist.

options.title: Pause pending sponsorship
options.body: Keep this protected draft open but stop repair and landing work until an authorized maintainer explicitly sponsors RFC 0016.

options.title: Sponsor and repair
options.body: Approve the direction, then require canonical state ownership and orphan-safe provenance before merge.

options.title: Decline the RFC
options.body: Close the associated implementation stack if this lifecycle is not planned for core.

recommendation.title: Pause pending sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep this protected draft open but stop repair and landing work until an authorized maintainer explicitly sponsors RFC 0016.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest repository-history owner for canonical shared state and core lifecycle acceptance.
